[[Grawl Ulodyte]]s are the powerful shamans of the [[Grawl]]. In combat, they provide a lot of healing support for [[Grawl (Ascalon)|Grawl warriors]]. It may be difficult to defeat groups of Grawl if they have multiple Ulodytes.
